data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure and step order (Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels > Tolls by vehicle > select vehicle type) and gets the main vehicle_type parameter right, but it leaves out the facility parameter and hedges between navigation paths ("or Fares & Tolls", "Tolls by vehicle / Toll Rates"), which makes it a little vague to automate.
